Mont Ventoux observatory: 60-cm reflector (2017), 20-cm outreach refractor. ~195 useful nights/year (168 in 2024). ~400 GB/month archived nightly to Marseille (40 min transfer).

Main camera replaced March 2025 (lower read noise); firmware update pending—needs one full night offline. Incidents: 2023 dome motor seizure bent a counterweight rod (fixed; limit switch added); Feb 2025 lost three weeks of photometry from an unnoticed 1.2-s timestamp offset (now GPS-checked each session).

Rules: no observing during outreach evenings; raw frames never deleted, compressed after two years; acquisition-software changes need a test night.

Pending: Spanish simultaneous-observation collaboration—shared scheduling tool unevaluated; network capacity for simultaneous transfers unknown.
